title: App-defined Colorado reporting regions

steps: Hand-drawn approximate polygons from named landmarks (config.yaml), applied in priority order; each published polygon is its configured polygon minus higher-priority regions, clipped to the Colorado bounding box. 'other' is the remainder.

limitations: These are app-defined approximations for reporting and filtering only. They are not official, land-management or CAIC forecast-zone boundaries, and must not be used to choose a forecast.
The Colorado outline is approximated by its bounding box.
